responsibility: Declares internal helper interfaces for RVV RTL construction, centered on the `rvv_builder` class used to analyze and synthesize constant vector representations. It exposes mask/vector mode queries and builder operations for detecting repeating or structured element sequences, choosing merge/slide-based constructions, and validating vector immediates, making it the internal constant-vector construction API used by RVV code generation rather than the public user intrinsic header.
same_name_distinction: This is the header half of the riscv-v pair: it declares the internal RVV helper interface, especially the rvv_builder class and function prototypes, while the same-stem riscv-v.cc provides the actual helper implementations and RTL-emission logic.
